summary: Unicycive Therapeutics filed an 8-K on September 29, 2026, reporting the appointment of Meredith S. Manning as an independent director effective October 1, 2026. She will serve on the Audit, Compensation and Nominating and Corporate Governance Committees, chairing the latter. The filing details her 25-plus years of biopharma experience, including roles at Soleno, PharmaEssentia, and Shire, but discloses no compensatory arrangements, shareholder agreement, or immediate operational impact. This is a routine board appointment rather than an abrupt forced departure, so it is conservatively treated as an administrative governance event. No deal terms, premium, or closing conditions are stated; risk-arb relevance is minimal.
